messages:
samir: FYI starting a KV-cache rehydrate/backfill tonight 02:00 UTC to recompute per-route aggregate tokens for 2026-03-12..2026-03-18. We saw undercounts from late SQS ordering + a parquet writer edge case.

maya: What's the plan for rollout? window, concurrency, and throttles?

samir: Plan: run a replay job that replays canonical events to the aggregator with idempotency keys. Start at 02:00, ramp over 30m, parallel=6, pause on latency spikes >200ms. We'll skip events older than 30 days and skip duplicates by idempotency. cc @oncall-bot for alerts.

josh: Can we canary EU routes first? Also we need a temporary dashboard showing "recompute in progress" and processed counts.

nina: I can add a Grafana panel and a quick Prometheus rule. Which metric names do you want?

samir: Use "telemetry.recompute.in_progress" and "telemetry.recompute.processed_count". Also emit a tag "replay_job_id" on metrics. I'll open the patch after this thread.

eli: Ops question: will this spike committed capacity (Dedicated) or conflict with customer quotas? We don’t want to trigger billing alerts.

samir: We'll route replay traffic to the internal-replay model variant which is excluded from customer quotas and billed to the internal account. Router policy uses origin=internal-replay -> dedicated-internal pool. Josh please confirm router mapping exists.

josh: :thumbsup: confirmed the mapping exists in prod-router v3. I’ll also add a safety rule to cap QPS at 200 for the replay pool.

replay-bot: replay-bot: job queued job_id=rb-20260320-7, segments=42, est_time=2h30m

maya: Nice. Who's on call if the aggregator starts dropping or error rate increases?

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: paging @nina @eli for the 02:00 UTC window

nina: I’ll be up from 01:45 UTC. I’ll tail aggregator errors and watch consumer lag. I’ll also push a small script to compute sanity counts.

samir: Command we'll use:
```
replay run --from 2026-03-12 --to 2026-03-18 \\
  --topic=telemetry-events --parallel=6 --idempotency=true \\
  --tag=internal-replay
```
Monitor: grafana (dashboard: telemetry/recompute) and Prometheus alert "RecomputeErrorRate > 0.5% for 5m".

eli: If the recomputed counts differ >1% vs last-run baseline we abort and only reprocess the offending segments. Also capture a sample set for quality evals.

maya: Agreed. Post to #incidents if error rate >5% or customer-facing SLOs degrade.

samir: Starting the job at 02:00 UTC. I’ll post job_id when live. Anything else?

josh: Please add the job id to the rollout doc and link dashboard.

samir: done — job_id=rb-20260320-7. closing thread.
